theorems.name: Submission.codim1_cone_offvertex_unit_multiplicity_rep
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m), 1 ≤ m → IsIntegerMultiplicity C → IsConeCurrent C → (∀ y ∈ C.support, y ≠ 0 → y ∈ regularSet C ∧ HasMassDensity C y 1) → ∃ ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P m, IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m (C.support \ {0}) ∧ IsOrientation m (C.support \ {0}) ξ ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ x ∈ C.support \ {0}, t • x ∈ C.support \ {0}) ∧ (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μHE[m] ((C.support \ {0}) ∩ K) ≠ ∞) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, C ω = ∫ x in C.support \ {0}, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x) ∂μHE[m]
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
